summary: Per-frame suspension force initialization and damping-rate recomputation. Zeroes the per-wheel spring and damper force accumulators, applies brake-cooling post-treatment when the cooling threshold is crossed, and, only when the requested rate index changed, re-selects a damping rate from a lookup table and recomputes combined rate/inverse pairs for three suspension layouts (types 0, 1 and 2). Called from PhysicsIntegrationStateMachine (0x004E4E60).

operations.description: Zero the per-wheel spring force accumulator dwords at +0x354C through +0x3558.
Zero the per-wheel damper force accumulator dwords at +0x355C and +0x3560.
If the brake-cooling threshold float at +0x3A04 is greater than 0.0, run brake cooling post-treatment.
Call BrakeCoolingPostTreatment() with no arguments when the cooling threshold at +0x3A04 is positive.
Read the requested damping-rate index from +0x39F0.
Only when the index at +0x39F0 differs from the cached index at +0x39F4 are the rate tables recomputed; otherwise the cached tables stay valid and the branch chain is skipped.
Update the cached index at +0x39F4 to the current requested value.

Select the damping-rate value: index 0 stores zero at +0x39C8; otherwise clamp index -1 to 0 and copy the entry from the rate lookup table (element stride 4, base +0x39CC for indices up to 7, base +0x4820 above 7) into +0x39C8.
Compute v4 = rate at +0x39C8 squared times the factor at +0x3988.
Read the single-precision constants at 0x0059E43C, 0x0059E440, 0x0059E450 and 0x0059E7F8 used as coefficients in the damping-rate recomputation arithmetic.
Dispatch on the suspension-type selector at +0x39B4: values 0, 1 and 2 select different damping-rate recomputation paths.
Type 0: combined rate v10 = 0.5 * v4 + base rate at +0x37D4, then store the rate and its inverse at +0x37D8/+0x37DC and again at +0x38D0/+0x38D4.

Type 1: four iterations stepping the target pointer by 0xF8 (248), each adding 0.25 * v4 to a base rate read 0xFC (252) bytes ahead of the slot and writing the combined rate 0xF8 (248) bytes in and its inverse 0xF4 (244) bytes in; the four slot bases include +0x35E4 and +0x37D4 plus two intermediate slots not listed in the packet.
Type 2: combined rate v6 = 0.5 * v4 + base rate at +0x35E4, then store the rate and its inverse at +0x35E8/+0x35EC and again at +0x36E0/+0x36E4.
Return whatever value survived the branch chain: the requested index when no recomputation ran, zero for types 0 and 2, or an interior pointer for type 1. Not a semantically meaningful API result.
